preconditions: Owned current-schema SourceRelations and optional effective configuration values; no project loading, graph traversal or configuration inference.
steps: Classify unconditional and conditional stored artifacts with and without an explicitly resolved configuration.
Evaluate allowed SRX expressions against effective values and constant common artifact metadata; require a Boolean result and reject project, relation, graph and nonmetadata access.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ohne ausgewählte Konfiguration MUSS ein Artefakt ohne `applicability` als anwendbar und ein Artefakt mit `applicability` als potenziell anwendbar behandelt werden.
oracle.scope: Supplied artifact applicability only: applicable, excluded and potentially_applicable are distinct. Missing configuration leaves conditions unevaluated after static validation. Common stored snapshot metadata excludes relations, applicability and derived/content fields; errors never become exclusion.

open_items: Complete 9.c.R/C robustness and pure scope-stage integration. Scope closure, configuration-bound gates and command integration remain assigned to later M9 steps; no project or release approval is claimed.
